text: Silicon microring resonators drift at about 69 pm/K, so every ring in a ring-based photonic network-on-chip needs active thermal ___ that consumes 0.5-2 mW each.
explanation: Active thermal stabilization (a heater plus feedback) holds each ring on resonance against the 69 pm/K drift, and at 0.5-2 mW per ring this dominates the optical energy budget of ring-based PNoC. It is the central practical challenge for the approach.
